Value.quote: For the fourth quarter of 2026, AMD expects revenue to be approximately $17 billion, plus or minus 3%.
Value.summary_en: Fourth quarter 2026 revenue expected at approximately $17 billion, plus or minus 3%.

Value.quote: The mid-point of the revenue range represents year-over-year growth of approximately 66% and a sequential increase of approximately 27%.
Value.summary_en: Revenue range mid-point implies approximately 66% year-over-year growth and approximately 27% sequential increase.

Value.quote: Non-GAAP gross margin is expected to be approximately 55%.
Value.summary_en: Non-GAAP gross margin expected at approximately 55% for the fourth quarter.

Value.quote: Data Center segment revenue was a record $8.5 billion, up 97% year-over-year, driven by strong demand for AMD EPYC™ processors and the launch of AMD Instinct™ MI450 Series GPUs.
Value.summary_en: Data Center segment revenue reached a record $8.5 billion, up 97% year-over-year on EPYC and Instinct MI450 demand.

Value.quote: Client and Gaming segment revenue was $3.7 billion, down 8% year-over-year.
Value.summary_en: Client and Gaming segment revenue was $3.7 billion, down 8% year-over-year.

Value.quote: Embedded segment revenue was $1.1 billion, up 29% year-over-year, led by growth in aerospace and defense, automotive, communications and industrial end markets.
Value.summary_en: Embedded segment revenue was $1.1 billion, up 29% year-over-year across aerospace, automotive, communications and industrial markets.

Value.quote: AMD announced an agreement to acquire World Labs, bringing leading model research expertise to AMD to help shape superintelligence infrastructure and strengthen the open ecosystem.
Value.summary_en: AMD announced an agreement to acquire World Labs to add model research expertise and strengthen the open ecosystem.
